Proc.name: DATA
Proc.description:
Creates a new data table from external files or existing tables, or builds one from scratch.
Note: WORK tables are kept in memory only and not saved to disk.

Proc.name: PROC
Proc.description: Core FrontScript Procedure Step. Followed by STEP options.

Proc.name: TYPE
Proc.description: Variable or column data type. Can be BOOLEN, BYTE CHAR, DATE, DOUBLE, INTEGER, LOGICAL, LONG, REAL, STRING or  TEXT.

Proc.name: ODS
Proc.description: Directs output of other steps to destinations like Office, HTML, or Listings.

Proc.name: CONVERTCURR
Proc.description: Converts currency values using specified FX rates in cubes (used in Cube programs).

Proc.name: DELETE
Proc.description: Removes an eFront Cube cube from the eFront Cube server. Applies only to eFront Cube programs.

Proc.name: DIRECTCASHFLOWS
Proc.description: Generates an eFront Report table returning direct cash flow transaction IDs for a set of instruments and/or transactions via the Calculation Engine (DCE). Not available for eFront Cube programs.

Proc.name: EFRONTACCRUALS
Proc.description: Generates a table that calculates accrued interests per instrument for a given date.

Proc.name: EFRONTBLOB
Proc.description: Exports data from an eFront Invest blob field (or collection of blob fields) into an eFront Report table.
Proc.example:
PROC EFRONTBLOB DATA="BLOB_TABLE" ID="BLOB_ID" CLASS="Deal" PATH="MyPath" OUT=WORK.BLOB_OUT;
RUN;

Proc.name: EFRONTDASHBOARD
Proc.description: Exports a dashboard as a PDF file.

Proc.name: EFRONTFOLDER
Proc.description: Retrieves data from a specific folder object in eFront.
Proc.example:
PROC EFRONTFOLDER FOLDER="Deal" ID="123" PROPERTIES="PropertyName";
RUN;

Proc.name: EFRONTIMPORT
Proc.description: Imports data from an eFront Report table using a predefined import mask.

Proc.name: EFRONTIMPORT_AJX
Proc.description: Executes a specific sheet import from a registered FIA import definition.
Proc.example:
PROC EFRONTIMPORT_AJX DATA=WORK.IMPORTTABLE NAME="IMPORT_MASK" SHEETNAME="Sheet1";
RUN;

Proc.name: EFRONTMAIL
Proc.description: Triggers the automatic sending of emails using column values from a table for TO, CC, subject, body, and attachments.
Proc.example:
PROC EFRONTMAIL DATA=WORK.MAILTABLE TO=EMAIL SUBJECT=SUBJ BODY=TEXT;
RUN;

Proc.name: EFRONTMENUS
Proc.description: Retrieves all user menus and submenus from application configuration.

Proc.name: EFRONTPACKAGES
Proc.description: Returns details on integrated packages and options in the application.

Proc.name: EFRONTPROFILES
Proc.description: Retrieves user profile definitions from the application.

Proc.name: EFRONTREGIONS
Proc.description: Retrieves user region settings and access rights.

Proc.name: EFRONTTABLES
Proc.description: Returns metadata about data model: tables, columns, indexes, and relationships.

Proc.name: EFRONTUSERPROFILES
Proc.description: Retrieves user profile assignments in the application.

Proc.name: ERROR
Proc.description: Stops program execution and raises an error with a custom message.

Proc.name: EXPORTCHART
Proc.description: Exports charts from Excel files as JPEG images.

Proc.name: EXPORTEXCEL
Proc.description: Exports one or more tables to individual sheets of a single Excel workbook.

Proc.name: EXPORT
Proc.description: Exports a table or view in CSV format to disk.

Proc.name: FAQUERY
Proc.description: Exports the result of a QueryBuilder query into an eFront Report table.
Proc.example:
PROC FAQUERY QUERY="SELECT * FROM Table";
RUN;

Proc.name: FORMAT
Proc.description: Creates custom formats for data display using VALUE or PICTURE definitions.

Proc.name: FUNDCASHFLOWS
Proc.description: Extracts investor operation IDs via the Calculation Engine (fund investments).

Proc.name: GCHART
Proc.description: Generates chart types such as pie, bar, donut from a report table.

Proc.name: GPLOT
Proc.description: Creates plots and line charts from an eFront Report data table. Charts can include pies, bars, and donuts.

Proc.name: MEMORY
Proc.description: Displays memory use for tables or unloads them.

Proc.name: MEANS
Proc.description: Calculates basic statistics like mean, sum, min, max on a table.

Proc.name: OFFICE
Proc.description: Generates Office/Word/Excel/XML files using templates and input tables.

Proc.name: PRINT
Proc.description: Prints tables or specific variables using a customizable layout.

Proc.name: PRINTCOL
Proc.description: Prints a column from a table into a multi-column layout.

Proc.name: PRINTFORM
Proc.description: Prints formatted forms using fixed layout specifications.

Proc.name: SENDTOIC
Proc.description:
Sends documents (PDF, DOCX) from eFront Invest to Investment Café Classic.
⚠️ DEPRECATED as of V21.0.

Proc.name: SETFILTER
Proc.description: Filters automatically an eFront Cube cube according to defined filter expressions, at the moment when it is accessed by a dashboard.

Proc.name: SORT
Proc.description: Sorts tables by one or more character/numeric columns.

Proc.name: SQLEXEC
Proc.description: Executes SQL queries against an external database.
Proc.example:
PROC SQLEXEC CONNECTION="DB_CONN" SQL="SELECT * FROM customers";
RUN;

Proc.name: SQLIMPORT
Proc.description: Imports external SQL query results into an eFront Report table.

Proc.name: SQLTABLE
Proc.description: Exports eFront Report table data to an external SQL database.
Proc.example:
PROC SQLTABLE DATA=WORK.MYTABLE CONNECTION="DB_CONN" TABLE="target_table";
RUN;

Proc.name: TABULATE
Proc.description: Creates pivot tables and computes statistics grouped by dimensions.

Proc.name: TRANSPOSE
Proc.description: Transposes column values into rows in an output table.

Proc.name: TRANSPOSE2
Proc.description: Reshapes table by turning variable values into new columns.

Proc.name: UPDATE
Proc.description: Performs high-performance merging of two cubes (left join style).

Proc.name: WSGETCOMPANYDATA
Proc.description: Calls a web service to retrieve company data.

Proc.name: WSGETINVESTMENTDATA
Proc.description: Calls a web service to retrieve investment data.

Proc.name: WSGETINVESTORSDATA
Proc.description: Calls a web service to retrieve investor data.

Proc.name: STYLESHEET
Proc.description: Defines styles applicable to programming step elements (e.g., charts, table cells).

Proc.name: TABLE
Proc.description: Dispatches printed output in an HTML table.

Proc.name: EXCEL
Proc.description: Generates an .XLS file with data from an eFront Report input table.

Proc.name: UPDATEFOLDER
Proc.description: Updates a WebEdge folder in eFront.

Macro.name: DEFINE
Macro.description: Macro Statement. Declares the existence of a macro (flag). Use EXISTMACRO() to test if a macro has been defined.

Macro.name: INCLUDE
Macro.description: Macro Function. Includes the contents of an external FrontScript file.

Macro.name: LET
Macro.description: Macro Statement. Defines a macro variable and assigns a static value to it. Values are character strings.

Macro.name: PARAM
Macro.description: Macro Function. Declares a macro parameter for dynamic input.
Macro.example: %PARAM EXCLUDEDRAFT LABEL "Exclude Draft transactions?" TYPE= BOOLEAN;

Macro.name: CONTINUE
Macro.description: Macro Statement. Exits the current iteration of a macro control loop and jumps to the following statement. Valid inside %DO WHILE...%LOOP, %FOR...%NEXT, and %WHILE...%END loops.

Keyword.name: ABORT
Keyword.description: Stops program execution with an error.
Keyword.example: IF status = 'FAIL' THEN ABORT;

Keyword.name: ARRAY
Keyword.description: Valid in: DATA steps. Establishes a link between 1 single column and a group of columns. The single column becomes an array, and each element of the group of columns becomes an array element. Each array element can be accessed through an array index used together with the name of the array column.

Keyword.name: BOX
Keyword.description: Valid in: PROC TABULATE steps. Specifies text and style elements for the empty box above row titles. CLASS, VAR, and TABLE statements are required.

Keyword.name: BREAK
Keyword.description:
Exits the current loop or SELECT structure.

Can be Macro (%) function too.

Keyword.name: BY
Keyword.description: Specifies grouping criteria for procedures like SORT or MEANS.
Keyword.example: BY region;

Keyword.name: CASE
Keyword.description:
Defines a value or condition in a switch-style structure (sometimes used interchangeably with WHEN).

Can be Macro (%) function too.

Keyword.name: CLASS
Keyword.description: Defines classification variables in procedures like TABULATE.
Keyword.example: CLASS department;

Keyword.name: COLUMN
Keyword.description: Defines a column to be printed or used in a table layout.
Keyword.example: COLUMN name age salary;

Keyword.name: CONTINUE
Keyword.description:
Exits the current control and jumps to the next statement in a loop.

Can be Macro (%) function too.

Keyword.name: DEFAULT
Keyword.description: Defines the default block to execute in a SELECT if no WHEN condition is matched.

Keyword.name: DO
Keyword.description:
Begins a code block or loop.

Can be Macro (%) function too.

Keyword.name: DONUT
Keyword.description: Generates a donut chart.

Keyword.name: DONUT3D
Keyword.description: Valid in: PROC GCHART steps. Defines a 3-dimensional donut chart. The DONUT3D statement specifies the column(s) whose values to include in the chart. At least one column is required.

Keyword.name: DROP
Keyword.description: Applies a conditional filter to remove colmns in procedures or data steps.
Keyword.example: SET transactions (DROP = Colx Coly);

Keyword.name: ELSE
Keyword.description:
Specifies an alternate block to execute if the IF condition is false.

Can be Macro (%) function too.
Keyword.example: IF x = 1 THEN y = 'Yes'; ELSE y = 'No';

Keyword.name: ELSEIF
Keyword.description:
Specifies an alternate block to execute if the IF condition is false.

Can be Macro (%) function too.
Keyword.example: IF x = 1 THEN y = 'Yes'; ELSEIF x = 0 then y= 'No'; END; ;

Keyword.name: END
Keyword.description:
Closes a block of code (e.g., IF, DO, SELECT).

Can be Macro (%) function too.

Keyword.name: EXPORT
Keyword.description: Exports data to a file format (CSV, Excel, etc.).
Keyword.example:
PROC EXPORT DATA=work.table OUTFILE='output.csv';
RUN;

Keyword.name: EXTEND
Keyword.description: Valid in: DATA steps. Reads all the lines from 1 or more existing cubes into an output table. If you specify more than one cube, cubes are appended to each other. Applies only to eFront Cube programs. Similar to SET but cannot add or remove rows, and has better performance as impacted columns are not recalculated.

Keyword.name: FIRST
Keyword.description: Refers to the first record in a BY group.
Keyword.example: IF FIRST.name THEN counter = 0;

Keyword.name: FOR
Keyword.description: Begins a counted loop that runs from a start value to an end value.

Keyword.name: FORMAT
Keyword.description: Applies a user-defined format to variables.
Keyword.example: FORMAT salary dollar12.2;

Keyword.name: HBAR
Keyword.description: Generates a horizontal bar chart.

Keyword.name: HBAR3D
Keyword.description: Valid in: PROC GCHART steps. Defines a chart with horizontal three-dimensional bars. The HBAR3D statement specifies the column(s) whose values to include in the chart. At least one column is required.

Keyword.name: ID
Keyword.description: Valid in: PROC TRANSPOSE steps. Identifies the input table column whose formatted values name the variables being transposed. eFront Script uses the values of the specified column as names for the new columns.

Keyword.name: IDLABEL
Keyword.description: Valid in: PROC TRANSPOSE steps. Identifies the column labels for the variables being transposed. eFront Script uses the values of the specified column as labels for the new columns. Labels display when using the PROC PRINT step with the LABEL option.

Keyword.name: IF
Keyword.description:
Executes a block of code if a condition is true.

Can be Macro (%) function too.
Keyword.example: IF amount > 1000 THEN PUT 'Large';

Keyword.name: INFILE
Keyword.description: Reads data from an external file line by line.
Keyword.example: INFILE 'data.csv' DLM=',';

Keyword.name: INFORMAT
Keyword.description: Option used with the %PARAM macro statement. Identifies a list of default values to display for interactive user input choice. The user can choose one or more values. According to the informat, the data_container varies, as does the type of values returned.

Keyword.name: INLINE
Keyword.description: Defines inline data directly within a script.

Keyword.name: IRR
Keyword.description: Valid in: PROC MEANS steps. Calculates the Internal Rate of Return. Column values must correspond to cashflow values. Options: NAME (output column name), LABEL, DATE (date column for non-annualized calculation), RESIDUALVALUE, RESIDUALDATE.

Keyword.name: JOIN
Keyword.description: Used in PROC MEANS to join the input table with another table on matching key columns.

Keyword.name: KEEP
Keyword.description: Applies a conditional filter to columns in procedures or data steps.
Keyword.example: SET transactions (KEEP = Col1 Col2);

Keyword.name: LAST
Keyword.description: Refers to the last record in a BY group.
Keyword.example: IF LAST.name THEN PUT 'End of group';

Keyword.name: LIBNAME
Keyword.description: Global statement. Assigns an alias to a library (folder). Must precede all programs that read from or write to the library. Use LIBNAME WORK DISK to store tables on disk instead of memory.

Keyword.name: LOOP
Keyword.description:
Marks the body of a WHILE or FOR loop.

Can be Macro (%) function too.

Keyword.name: MAX
Keyword.description: Specifies a variable for which the maximum value is computed.
Keyword.example: MAX temperature;

Keyword.name: MEAN
Keyword.description: Specifies a variable for which the average is computed.
Keyword.example: MEAN salary;

Keyword.name: MERGE
Keyword.description: Combines datasets based on key variables.

Keyword.name: MIN
Keyword.description: Specifies a variable for which the minimum value is computed.
Keyword.example: MIN humidity;

Keyword.name: MULTIPLE
Keyword.description: Valid in: PROC MEANS steps. Returns the multiple of the return on investment. DATE and AMOUNT options are required. Options: NAME (output column name), DATE, AMOUNT, LABEL.

Keyword.name: N
Keyword.description: Valid in: PROC MEANS steps. Counts the number of variable instances (non missing values). Options: NAME (output column name), LABEL.

Keyword.name: NEXT
Keyword.description: Ends the current iteration of a FOR loop and begins the next one.

Keyword.name: NOBS
Keyword.description: Returns the number of observations in a table.
Keyword.example: IF _N_ = 1 THEN SET data NOBS=n;

Keyword.name: ODS
Keyword.description: Directs output to destinations like HTML, RTF, or Excel.
Keyword.example:
ODS HTML FILE='report.html';
RUN;

Keyword.name: OUTPUT
Keyword.description: Writes a data row to the output table.
Keyword.example: OUTPUT;

Keyword.name: PICTURE
Keyword.description: Valid in: PROC FORMAT steps. Specifies a template (= picture) for formatting numeric values. You can use several PICTURE statements in a PROC FORMAT step.

Keyword.name: PIE
Keyword.description: Generates a pie chart.

Keyword.name: PIE3D
Keyword.description: Valid in: PROC GCHART steps. Defines a 3-dimensional pie chart. The PIE3D statement specifies the column(s) whose values to include in the chart. Each pie slice represents the value of the chart statistic for a particular column in relation to the total. At least one column is required.

Keyword.name: PLOT
Keyword.description: Valid in: PROC GPLOT steps. Defines a plots & lines chart. The PLOT statement specifies the column(s) whose values to include in the chart. At least one col_1*col_2 pair is required. Options: INTERPOL (line type: SPLINE|JOIN|STEP), SYMBOL (plot type: SQUARE|DIAMOND|PLUS|X|CIRCLE|STAR|TRIANGLE etc.).

Keyword.name: PRINT
Keyword.description: Prints the contents of a dataset or report.
Keyword.example:
PROC PRINT DATA=work.table;
RUN;

Keyword.name: PUT
Keyword.description: Writes a message or variable value to the log/output stream.
Keyword.example: PUT 'Processing complete';

Keyword.name: RECURSE
Keyword.description: Valid in: DATA steps. Generates dependency links from a table that includes Parent/Child informations. The COLUMN statement is required to list dependency links. Use the _LEVEL_ variable to display levels of hierarchy. Options: VAR (child column), PARENT (parent column), START (starting expression) — VAR and PARENT are required.

Keyword.name: RETURN
Keyword.description: Exits the current program or function and optionally returns a value.
Keyword.example: IF error = 1 THEN RETURN;

Keyword.name: RUN
Keyword.description: Executes a PROC or DATA step.

Keyword.name: SELECT
Keyword.description:
Begins a conditional branching block, like a switch statement.

Can be Macro (%) function too.

Keyword.name: SET
Keyword.description: Reads data into a DATA step from an existing table.

Keyword.name: SORT
Keyword.description: Sorts a dataset by one or more variables.

Keyword.name: SQL
Keyword.description: Introduces an SQL code block inside a program.

Keyword.name: STOP
Keyword.description: Terminates the program immediately.
Keyword.example: IF x > 100 THEN STOP;

Keyword.name: SUM
Keyword.description: Specifies a variable to be summed in statistics or MEANS table.
Keyword.example: SUM FEES  (NAME = FEES LABEL = "Fees");

Keyword.name: TABLE
Keyword.description: Defines the structure or layout of an output table.
Keyword.example:
PROC TABLE DATA=work.summary;
RUN;

Keyword.name: TEMPLATE
Keyword.description: Valid in: PROC OFFICE, PROC EXCEL steps. Calls the template file to be used to create a WORD, EXCEL or XML report. The file name must be prefixed with &.

Keyword.name: THEN
Keyword.description:
Follows an IF condition to specify the block to execute if true.

Can be Macro (%) function too.
Keyword.example: IF status = 'ACTIVE' THEN output = 1;

Keyword.name: TITLE
Keyword.description: Adds a title to output listings or reports.
Keyword.example: TITLE 'Summary Report';

Keyword.name: TRACE
Keyword.description: Outputs debug information or execution trace.
Keyword.example: TRACE 'Step 1 completed';

Keyword.name: TWR
Keyword.description: Valid in: PROC MEANS steps. Calculates the Time Weighted Return using the modified Dietz method. Options: NAME, LABEL, DATE (cashflow date), RESIDUALVALUE, RESIDUALDATE, NAV, GROUPBY, MONTH, DAY, FREQUENCY, ANNUALIZED, TWRTODATE (QTD|YTD), and others.

Keyword.name: UPDATE
Keyword.description: Updates an existing dataset with new values.
Keyword.example: UPDATE base SET salary = salary * 1.05 WHERE dept = 'HR';

Keyword.name: VALUE
Keyword.description: Assigns or retrieves a formatted value.

Keyword.name: VAR
Keyword.description: Defines variables for analysis or output.
Keyword.example: VAR sales profit;

Keyword.name: VBAR
Keyword.description: Generates a vertical bar chart.

Keyword.name: VBAR3D
Keyword.description: Valid in: PROC GCHART steps. Defines a chart with vertical three-dimensional bars. The VBAR3D statement specifies the column(s) whose values to include in the chart. At least one column is required.

Keyword.name: WHEN
Keyword.description:
Defines a specific condition inside a SELECT block.

Can be Macro (%) function too.

Keyword.name: WHERE
Keyword.description: Applies a conditional filter to rows in procedures or data steps.
Keyword.example:
SET transactions;
WHERE amount > 1000;

Keyword.name: WHILE
Keyword.description:
Starts a loop that continues while a condition is true.

Can be Macro (%) function too.

Function.name: ABS
Function.description: Returns the absolute (non-negative) value of a number.

Function.name: ACOS
Function.description: Returns the arccosine of a value, in radians.

Function.name: ASIN
Function.description: Returns the arcsine of a value, in radians.

Function.name: ATAN
Function.description: Returns the arctangent of a value, in radians.

Function.name: CBOOL
Function.description: Converts a value to a Boolean (TRUE/FALSE).

Function.name: CDATE
Function.description: Converts a value to a date type.

Function.name: CDBL
Function.description: Converts a value to a floating-point number.

Function.name: CEILING
Function.description: Rounds a number up to the nearest integer.

Function.name: CINT
Function.description: Converts a value to an integer.

Function.name: COS
Function.description: Returns the cosine of a number (in radians).

Function.name: COSH
Function.description: Returns the hyperbolic cosine of a number.

Function.name: CSTR
Function.description: Converts a value to a string.

Function.name: DISTRIBNORM
Function.description: Returns a value from a normal distribution.

Function.name: DISTRIBTRIANG
Function.description: Returns a value from a triangular distribution.

Function.name: E
Function.description: Returns Euler‚Äôs number (~2.718).

Function.name: EXP
Function.description: Returns e raised to the power of a number.

Function.name: FLOOR
Function.description: Rounds a number down to the nearest integer.

Function.name: LOG
Function.description: Returns the natural logarithm of a number.

Function.name: LOG10
Function.description: Returns the base-10 logarithm of a number.

Function.name: MAX
Function.description: Returns the maximum value among arguments.

Function.name: MIN
Function.description: Returns the minimum value among arguments.

Function.name: N0
Function.description: Converts a number to integer format (no decimals).

Function.name: PI
Function.description: Returns the value of pi (~3.14159).

Function.name: POW
Function.description: Raises a number to the power of another number.

Function.name: RANDOM
Function.description: Returns a random number between 0 and 1.

Function.name: ROUND
Function.description: Rounds a number to the specified number of digits.

Function.name: ROUNDINGMETHOD
Function.description: Specifies the method to be used in rounding operations.

Function.name: RND
Function.description: Alias for RANDOM.

Function.name: SIN
Function.description: Returns the sine of a number (in radians).

Function.name: SINH
Function.description: Returns the hyperbolic sine of a number.

Function.name: SQRT
Function.description: Returns the square root of a number.

Function.name: TAN
Function.description: Returns the tangent of a number (in radians).

Function.name: TANH
Function.description: Returns the hyperbolic tangent of a number.

Function.name: TOBOOL
Function.description: Converts a value to Boolean.

Function.name: TODAT
Function.description: Converts a string to a date format.

Function.name: TODBL
Function.description: Converts a value to a double.

Function.name: TOINT
Function.description: Converts a value to an integer.

Function.name: TOSTR
Function.description: Converts a value to a string.

Function.name: ASC
Function.description: Returns the ASCII code of the first character of a string.

Function.name: CHR
Function.description: Returns the character corresponding to the specified ASCII code.

Function.name: COMPRESS
Function.description: Removes all spaces from a string.

Function.name: CRLF
Function.description: Returns a carriage return and line feed combination.

Function.name: FIND
Function.description: Returns the position of a substring within a string.

Function.name: FORMAT
Function.description: Applies a custom format to a value.

Function.name: INSTR
Function.description: Returns the position of one string within another.

Function.name: LANG
Function.description: Returns the current language code.

Function.name: LCASE
Function.description: Converts all characters of a string to lowercase.

Function.name: LEFT
Function.description: Returns the leftmost characters of a string.

Function.name: LEN
Function.description: Returns the length of a string.

Function.name: LENGTH
Function.description: Alias for LEN.

Function.name: LOWCASE
Function.description: Alias for LCASE.

Function.name: LTRIM
Function.description: Removes leading spaces from a string.

Function.name: MID
Function.description: Returns a substring from a string starting at a specified position.

Function.name: REPLACE
Function.description: Replaces all occurrences of a substring with another substring.

Function.name: RIGHT
Function.description: Returns the rightmost characters of a string.

Function.name: RTRIM
Function.description: Removes trailing spaces from a string.

Function.name: SPLIT
Function.description: Splits a string into parts based on a delimiter.

Function.name: STRIP
Function.description: Removes leading and trailing spaces from a string.

Function.name: SUBSTR
Function.description: Returns a portion of a string (substring).

Function.name: TRIM
Function.description: Removes leading and trailing whitespace from a string.

Function.name: UCASE
Function.description: Converts a string to uppercase.

Function.name: UPCASE
Function.description: Alias for UCASE.

Function.name: DATEADD
Function.description: Adds a time interval to a date.

Function.name: DATEDIFF
Function.description: Returns the difference between two dates.

Function.name: DATESERIAL
Function.description: Returns a date from specified year, month, and day.

Function.name: DAY
Function.description: Returns the day of the month from a date.

Function.name: DMY
Function.description: Creates a date from day, month, and year values.

Function.name: MDY
Function.description: Creates a date from month, day, and year values.

Function.name: MONTH
Function.description: Returns the month from a date.

Function.name: QUARTER
Function.description: Returns the quarter of the year for a date.

Function.name: QUARTERBEGDATE
Function.description: Returns the first day of the quarter for a given date.

Function.name: SEMESTERENDDATE
Function.description: Returns the last day of the semester for a given date.

Function.name: WEEKBEGDATE
Function.description: Returns the first day of the week for a given date.

Function.name: WEEKDAY
Function.description: Returns the day of the week (1‚Äì7) from a date.

Function.name: WEEKENDDATE
Function.description: Returns the last day of the week for a given date.

Function.name: WEEKOFYEAR
Function.description: Returns the week number of the year for a date.

Function.name: YEAR
Function.description: Returns the year part of a date.

Function.name: YEARBEGDATE
Function.description: Returns the first day of the year for a given date.

Function.name: YEARENDDATE
Function.description: Returns the last day of the year for a given date.

Function.name: YMD
Function.description: Creates a date from year, month, and day values.

Function.name: DIRECTORIES
Function.description: Returns a list of directory names in a given path.

Function.name: DIRECTORY
Function.description: Returns the name of a directory.

Function.name: DIRECTORYNAME
Function.description: Returns the directory portion of a file path.

Function.name: FILES
Function.description: Returns a list of file names in a directory.

Function.name: FILE
Function.description: Returns a file object by path.

Function.name: FILENAME
Function.description: Returns the name of a file from its path.

Function.name: FILESEXT
Function.description: Returns the extension of a file.

Function.name: LINKFILES
Function.description: Returns the list of linked files for a folder.

Function.name: LINKFILE
Function.description: Returns a linked file object.

Function.name: LINKFILENAME
Function.description: Returns the name of a linked file.

Function.name: LINKFILESEXT
Function.description: Returns the extension of a linked file.

Function.name: MAKEDIRECTORY
Function.description: Creates a new directory at a specified path.

Function.name: APPENDPDF
Function.description: Appends one PDF file to another.

Function.name: CURRLITERAL
Function.description: Returns the literal name of a currency.

Function.name: CONVERTCURR
Function.description: Converts an amount from one currency to another using cube FX rates.

Function.name: CONVERTCURR2
Function.description: Converts currencies using cube FX rates with dynamic options.

Function.name: COLLECTION
Function.description: Returns a collection of items matching criteria.

Function.name: EXISTCOLUMN
Function.description: Checks if a column exists in a table.

Function.name: EXISTMACRO
Function.description: Checks if a macro variable exists.

Function.name: EXISTTABLE
Function.description: Checks if a table exists in memory or on disk.

Function.name: GETTEMPPATH
Function.description: Returns the path to the temporary folder.

Function.name: GETACCOUNTID
Function.description: Returns the account ID of the current user.

Function.name: GETUSERID
Function.description: Returns the ID of the current user.

Function.name: GETUSERINFO
Function.description: Returns user metadata as a string.

Function.name: GETURLWEBSITE
Function.description: Returns the full URL of the current web application.

Function.name: CDATE
Function.description: Converts an expression into a date.

Function.name: DAYOFYEAR
Function.description: Returns the day number in the year (1 = Jan 1).

Function.name: DML
Function.description: Formats a date value into SQL Server-compatible format.

Function.name: FORMAT
Function.description: Applies a format to a value, including dates.

Function.name: MONTHBEGDATE
Function.description: Returns the first day of the month for a given date.

Function.name: MONTHENDDATE
Function.description: Returns the last day of the month for a given date.

Function.name: NOW
Function.description: Returns the current date and time.

Function.name: QUARTERENDDATE
Function.description: Returns the last day of the quarter for a given date.

Function.name: SEMESTER
Function.description: Returns the semester number (1 or 2) of the year.

Function.name: SEMESTERBEGDATE
Function.description: Returns the first day of the semester for a given date.

Function.name: TODAY
Function.description: Returns today’s date.

Function.name: TICKCOUNT
Function.description: Returns the number of milliseconds since system start.
